meta.title: Push notify with optional ClickSend SMS fallback
meta.description: PuSH-IT and ClickSend are separate steps — no code coupling between extensions.

options.sql: SELECT s.user_uuid, s.entity_id, s.endpoint, s.p256dh, s.auth, u.phone FROM push_subscriptions s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_uuid WHERE s.entity_id = :entityId AND s.active = 1

flow.text: Option A: second query for users without push. Option B: filter pushSend.results in a follow-up API using Repeat/Condition on status !== sent, then ClickSend fromQuery.

flow.name: smsFallbackQuery
